text:
sara-partners: Quick sync — Datadog + OpenTelemetry dashboard tile for HW SI marketplace listing. Need owner for tile packaging (GKE + airgap/private deployment), runbook, and demo smoke test. Ping if available today.

jason-obs: I can own dashboard templates. Question: do we ship dashboard as raw JSON bundles or use the Datadog dashboard API in the runbook for importer automation?

mike-eng: For private / airgapped installs, shipping JSON bundles + an importer script is more reliable. Avoid outbound API calls during install. Example importer command we usually recommend: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/dashboard" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "DD-API-KEY: <API_KEY>" \
  -d @dashboard.json
```
(we can wrap that in a small python script to retry and validate responses)

olivia-sw: Also need to confirm traces for airgapped Dedicated GPU customers — typical pattern: OTLP -> local collector -> HEC forwarder (or local datadog agent) so there's no direct outbound from model hosts.

andre-solution: Agreed. We should include a pre-baked collector config (OTLP receiver + datadog exporter) and a short checklist in the runbook: 1) Collector config file 2) Import dashboard JSON 3) API key injection / secret rotation notes 4) RBAC for dashboards 5) Smoke test steps.

liz-sales: Partner marketing wants a one-pager and joint blog. Sales needs at least a 2-week lead before public launch to prep materials and pipeline motions.

jason-obs: Proposed timeline: dashboard templates + collector config by EOW (Fri). Runbook draft by next Wed. Can we identify who picks up the importer script?

mike-eng: I'll take the importer script + unit test. I'll open a PR in obs-templates repo and add a tiny CLI that supports `--local` (read file) and `--api` (call datadog API).

sara-partners: Thanks. @mike-eng, @jason-obs, @olivia-sw — can we do a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT? Agenda: packaging format, airgap strategy, demo steps, announcement schedule. :calendar:

liz-sales: Please add me for the last 10 mins to align on messaging and sales enablement.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: meeting created: invite sent to #partnerships; calendar event ID 9a8b7c.

sara-partners: +1. I'll update the partnership tracker and attach the initial checklist. I'll also add a column for "airgap notes" so SIs can see support constraints.

jason-obs: One more ask — include a small set of sample traces + synthetic traffic for the smoke test. That helps validate sampling and screen recordings for partner demos.

mike-eng: Will add a small k6 script and sample trace payloads to the PR.

sara-partners: Perfect. Thanks all — see you tomorrow.
